long_biography.plain_text:
Property developer Jeffrey Soffer brought architect Robert Swedroe into Turnberry Ocean Club to make its interior layouts work as carefully as its exterior. The residential tower combined substantial homes with shared leisure facilities, while Soffer emphasised understanding how residents would actually use their space. Its design placed amenities high above the beach rather than confining them to ground level.

A pilot himself, Soffer also developed Fontainebleau Aviation as a business serving other aircraft owners. The operation combined hangars and maintenance with executive facilities and concierge services. Aviation customers also received VIP access to Turnberry hotels, including the Fontainebleau and Turnberry Isle.
